confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result showing the 18 Nov 2026 reading. The food and drink anchors come from one price search of crowd-sourced indexes (Numbeo via Expatica, CityCost, Livingcost, Seattle Magazine). Those indexes put meals at about $21–25, a dinner for two at about $100, cappuccino at about $6.5, draft beer at about $8 and cocktails at about $14. No source gave a restaurant wine-by-the-glass price. I estimated it from the $15–16 mid-range bottle price and the beer price, so it is less certain. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. They are the least certain, because Seattle prices swing seasonally and July is peak season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Seattle is treated as a high-cost US West Coast city, similar to Portland and San Francisco but slightly cheaper than San Francisco.
